description: This file defines the CreditCardPayment class, a subclass of Payment, representing a credit card transaction with associated details such as card number, validation number, expiration dates, owner's name, and credit card type.

classes.name: CreditCardPayment
classes.description: Represents a credit card payment transaction with associated card details.

methods.name: getCreditCardNumber
methods.description: Returns the credit card number used in the payment.

methods.name: setCreditCardNumber
methods.description: Sets the credit card number used in the payment.

methods.name: getCredidCardValidationNumber
methods.description: Returns the credit card validation (CVV) number.

methods.name: setCredidCardValidationNumber
methods.description: Sets the credit card validation (CVV) number.

methods.name: getExpirationMonth
methods.description: Returns the expiration month of the credit card.

methods.name: setExpirationMonth
methods.description: Sets the expiration month of the credit card.

methods.name: getExpirationYear
methods.description: Returns the expiration year of the credit card.

methods.name: setExpirationYear
methods.description: Sets the expiration year of the credit card.

methods.name: getCardOwner
methods.description: Returns the name of the card owner.

methods.name: setCardOwner
methods.description: Sets the name of the card owner.

methods.name: getCreditCard
methods.description: Returns the CreditCardType object associated with the payment.

methods.name: setCreditCard
methods.description: Sets the CreditCardType object for the payment.
